142	
143	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
144	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
145	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
146	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:
147	  `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/llms.txt`).

149	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
150	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are
151	  not 100% sure of, check `rules/hallucination-traps.md` (ecosystem patterns)
152	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
153	  rather than guessing.
154	- **Never guess icon names** — they are hallucinated more often than not. To
155	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
156	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on

158	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See
159	  `references/icons.md`.

161	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
162	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,
163	  a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, controls on a brand background) live in
164	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.

166	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
167	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.

173	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.

183	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
184	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
185	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.

188	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
189	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
190	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
191	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
192	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
193	  touching structure.

198

201	  offline fallback in Step 0.

205	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
206	  version-matched file.
207	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
208	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
209	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
210	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
211	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
212	  object-vs-string rendering rule.

214	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
215	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
216	  (partial brand overrides, a `ThemeProvider` that themes the whole page, customization
217	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
218	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.

A declarative React charting library for Gravity UI apps — render line, area, bar, pie, scatter, treemap, and other charts from a single `data` config, themed to match the rest of the app.

#### When to use

- Standard business charts: `line`, `area`, `bar-x`/`bar-y`, `pie`, `scatter`, `treemap`, `waterfall`, `sankey`, `radar`, `heatmap`, `funnel`, `x-range`.
- Visualizations that must follow Gravity UI theming (light/dark) and share tokens with a `@gravity-ui/uikit` app.
- Rendering a chart from declarative data rather than drawing imperatively.

#### When not to use

- Projects still on `@gravity-ui/chartkit` — that is the older adapter-based wrapper (YAGR/Highcharts/D3); this package is the modern standalone renderer and is not a drop-in replacement.
- Plain tabular data — use [`@gravity-ui/table`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/table).
- Non-React or server-only rendering — `Chart` renders React SVG and needs the DOM.

## Components — `@gravity-ui/components`

> If you need this library, read more at package [llms.txt](https://gravity-ui.com/llms/components/llms.txt)
> GitHub: [gravity-ui/components](https://github.com/gravity-ui/components)

The composite-component layer of Gravity UI — ready-made form rows, confirmation dialogs, notifications, stories, galleries and similar product-level widgets assembled from `@gravity-ui/uikit` primitives, so you do not rebuild them by hand.

#### When to use

- Form layout: `FormRow` (label + field + description) instead of a hand-made label/input wrapper.
- Confirmation flows: `ConfirmDialog` instead of composing `Dialog` with two buttons yourself.
- Product widgets: `Notifications`, `Stories` / `StoriesGroup`, `ChangelogDialog`, `OnboardingMenu`, `PromoSheet`, `CookieConsent`, `Reactions`, `SharePopover`, `StoreBadge`.
- Data helpers: `InfiniteScroll`, `ItemSelector`, `DelayedTextInput`, `TokenizedInput`, `Gallery`.

#### When not to use

- Basic controls, overlays, layout and theming — use [`@gravity-ui/uikit`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/uikit) directly; this package only adds composites on top of it.
- Data grids — use [`@gravity-ui/table`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/table); there is no table here.
- Date pickers and calendars — use [`@gravity-ui/date-components`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/date-components).
- Application navigation shells (aside header, footer) — use [`@gravity-ui/navigation`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/navigation).
- Schema-driven forms — use [`@gravity-ui/dynamic-forms`](https://github.com/gravity-ui/dynamic-forms); `FormRow` is only a layout row.

## DashKit — `@gravity-ui/dashkit`

> If you need this library, read more at package [llms.txt](https://gravity-ui.com/llms/dashkit/llms.txt)
> GitHub: [gravity-ui/dashkit](https://github.com/gravity-ui/dashkit)

A dashboard grid composer that arranges resizable, draggable widgets in a responsive grid via a plugin system — reach for it when you build a user-editable dashboard (add/move/resize/delete widgets) instead of placing individual charts or panels by hand.

#### When to use

- Rendering a configurable dashboard where widgets are positioned, resized, and rearranged on a grid (built on `react-grid-layout`).
- User-editable layouts: adding/removing widgets from an action panel, drag-and-drop, edit mode with overlay controls.
- Plugin-based widgets where each widget type (title, text, chart, custom) is registered once and driven by a `config`.

events.content:
Кнопка и модальное окно готовы в `src/App.tsx`. Клик по кнопке открывает окно с текстом и двумя действиями: «Подтвердить» и «Отмена». Оба действия закрывают окно. Typecheck (`tsc --noEmit`) и `vite build` проходят без ошибок.

**Что сделано**
- Кнопка — `Button` из `@gravity-ui/uikit` с `view="action"`.
- Окно — `ConfirmDialog` из `@gravity-ui/components`. Skill рекомендует его для подтверждений вместо ручной сборки `Dialog` с двумя кнопками. Заголовок «Подтверждение», текст «Вы уверены, что хотите выполнить это действие?».
- Состояние открытия хранится в `useState`. Крестик, Esc и клик по фону тоже закрывают окно.

**Решения, которые стоит проверить**
- **Новая зависимость.** `@gravity-ui/components` не был установлен, и я добавил его, как требует skill. Последняя версия (5.0.0) требует `@gravity-ui/uikit` ^8, а проект на 7.43.0. Поэтому я зафиксировал `@gravity-ui/components@4.23.1`: это самая новая версия с peer-зависимостью `^7.39.0`. Uikit не трогал. Если нужна версия 5, придётся обновлять uikit до 8.
- **Документация.** В установленном uikit 7.43.0 нет встроенной документации (она появилась с 7.45.0). Поэтому props проверил по `.d.ts` установленного пакета. Онлайн-документацию не запрашивал.
- **Действие «Подтвердить».** Сейчас оно только закрывает окно. Если нужна реальная операция, её можно добавить в `onClickButtonApply`.
- **Язык.** Тексты интерфейса на русском, как и ваш запрос.

**Что не проверено**
- В браузере я не запускал. Поведение проверено чтением кода и сборкой, а не визуально. Стоит проверить открытие и закрытие окна, светлую и тёмную темы, узкий экран.
- `npm install` сообщил о 5 уязвимостях в зависимостях (2 critical, 1 high). Это не связано с этой задачей, я их не трогал.

**Изменённые файлы:** `src/App.tsx`, `package.json` (добавлена `@gravity-ui/components`), `package-lock.json`.
